other_exits: Sell positions closed when Main Line was above Signal Line on previous bar (Ind[1]>Sign[1]) and BuyPosClose is enabled
Buy positions closed when Main Line was below Signal Line on previous bar (Ind[1]<Sign[1]) and SellPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. MM parameter (0.1) serves as either lot size or fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry crossover logic uses a two-bar comparison: Ind[1]>Sign[1] (previous bar: main above signal) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (current signal bar: main crossed to below or equal) triggers BUY_Open. This is inverted logic - a bullish crossover is detected when the main line was above signal on the prior bar and has now crossed down on the signal bar, which may indicate a mean-reversion or oversold bounce entry. Conversely, SELL_Open triggers when Ind[1]<Sign[1] AND Ind[0]>=Sign[0]. SignalBar=1 means the crossover is evaluated on the previous completed bar (bar 1) vs the bar before it (bar 0 relative to SignalBar offset). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are toggle inputs that can independently enable/disable long/short entries and exits. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on data issues.
python_conversion_notes: The CronexMFI custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It is a smoothed MFI with fast and slow moving averages applied to the raw MFI values. The smoothing method is configurable (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) via SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - only standard MA types (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA) can be directly translated; exotic smoothers (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) require separate implementations. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles position open/close with money management - must reimplement BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with equivalent logic. The GetStartBars function from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh calculates warmup periods for each smoother type. MarginMode-based position sizing requires mapping all 5 modes. Signal detection uses CopyBuffer with 2-element arrays comparing bar[1] vs bar[0] at the SignalBar offset - ensure indexing is correctly mapped from MT5's offset-based CopyBuffer to Python's array indexing.
